LESSON: MATCHING AND PAIRING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: PRE- NUMBER ACTIVITIES
Topic 1.2: Matching and Pairing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Matching and Pairing, part of PRE- NUMBER ACTIVITIES in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you match similar clothes that you wear? 2. How do you pair similar clothes that you wear?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Matching and Pairing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Signing/speaking skills; the learner signs/speaks clearly and effectively with others to

express their own ideas in groups or in pairs while matching and pairing of different clothes.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation; The learner works in groups to accomplish the task of matching and pairing clothes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self- care: Learners relate clothes to their use in daily life (sweater to keep one warm so that they don’t become sick).

Link to other activity areas:

The learner is able to relate the skills used in signing songs or sign poems in Mathematics activities to Language activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Different types of clothes (shorts, shirts, dresses, socks, sweater), digital devices picture of different types of clothes.
